parameters.name: MetaIds
parameters.description:
The metadata IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

You can obtain the exception ID on the **Exception Analysis** page of your application in the ARMS console.

parameters.name: MetaType
parameters.description:
The metadata type. Valid values:

*   sql: obtains an SQL statement based on sqlId.
*   exception: obtains the exception stack based on exceptionId.

parameters.name: Pid
parameters.description: The process identifier (PID) of the application. You can obtain the PID of an application by calling the **ListTraceApps** operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms query-app-metadata --meta-ids 4c9dd447,3c76c565 --meta-type sql --pid ggxw4lnjuz@54364d85b000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time-ms 1 --end-time-ms 1 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
